pages.text: $(li)Choose your folk.$(li)Open the quest book ($(k:key.ftbquests.quests)) and claim $(item)Choose Your Calling$(): your class kit.$(li)Tome in its slot, weapon in hand, cast.$(li)Join two jobs ($(k:key.jobsplus.open_menu)).$(li)Find your friends ($(k:key.partyhud.open_screen)).

You wake in a plains village with a map to the nearest tavern. For your first three minutes the world goes easy on you: take the time to look around.$(br2)The $(item)gazebo$() holds a Spell Binding Table, the class buildings sell gear for your calling, and the waystone brings you home from anywhere. The Hearthlands around you are the gentlest land there is.
